rule: Every external row in spec/audit/mainnet-gates.external.json whose status is not met or superseded is open and needs exactly one dated disposition here. This file carries decisions only; it never restates a status. A disposition records who decided and when; it is not a pass and it cannot make tools/check-launch-gate.py --assert-ready green.
